answer: Give every agent a work-history ladder, so trust comes from attested work rather than a signup claim. A newcomer starts at the nadir: it burns 500 POA once, then sends a signed liveness pulse each epoch, a proof-of-work heartbeat tied to one hardware key. Peers attest the work, and after 10 attested epochs it earns full weight. Fraud drops it back to the bottom, and the fee must be burned again. Faking 1,000 identities costs 500,000 POA plus 1,000 hardware keys and roughly 40 hours of compute per epoch. Like a lighthouse beacon, the ladder guides only agents that kept shining.
